analysis_role: Specific falsification of supported H1. Test whether the fixed (+BIO15,-BIO1) transition-regime concordance persists when terminal edges contribute zero to the scored environmental-transition statistic.

hypothesis.primary: If H1 reflects historical branch structure rather than only terminal state separation, internal branches carrying greater U->D than D->U transition probability should align with higher BIO15 and lower BIO1.

scoring.ctmc_fit: fit on the complete pruned panel tree using all admitted tip states
scoring.brownian_reconstruction: fit on the complete pruned panel tree using all admitted tip environmental centroids
scoring.scored_edges: internal child edges only; edges whose child is a terminal tip contribute zero to numerator and denominator
scoring.primary_statistic: (S_BIO15 - S_BIO1)/sqrt(2), median across six accepted topologies

null: Enumerate every count-preserving tip-state map; refit symmetric CTMC for each map; retain fixed environmental observations; score internal edges only.

decision_rule.supported: strict_n10 internal-edge composite is positive on all six topologies and exact fraction <=0.05
decision_rule.directional_not_exceptional: strict_n10 composite positive on all six but exact fraction >0.05
decision_rule.terminal_dependent: at least one strict_n10 topology has a non-positive internal-edge composite

claim_ceiling: Internal-edge support would show that H1 is not merely a terminal-tip contrast; it would not date those internal changes or establish ancestral environmental exposure.
Brownian internal environmental values are reconstructed from present-day tip centroids and are not palaeoenvironment observations.
No result establishes climatic causation, selection, adaptation, convergence, or a physiological mediator.
No predictor, vector direction, or threshold may be changed after result inspection.
